objective: Build a voice interface CLI that uses Whisper (local) for STT, Piper TTS (local) for output, 16kHz mono, 2s silence timeout, interrupt support. CLI: viral-dev voice listen --timeout 30s. Include tests.
acceptanceCriteria: Owner objective is satisfied: Build a voice interface CLI that uses Whisper (local) for STT, Piper TTS (local) for output, 16kHz mono, 2s silence timeout, interrupt support. CLI: viral-dev voice listen --timeout 30s. Include tests.
Repository rules and current approved milestone boundaries are preserved.
Relevant automated verification passes and continuity state is updated.
notes: Created from the owner-facing viral-dev objective command.
Efficiency selection: EXECUTE / CODING_HARNESS / MEDIUM. Selected claude with MEDIUM effort because development work requires an authenticated coding harness and the selected harness is usable.

Implemented under src/voice/: provider-neutral SpeechToTextPort, TextToSpeechPort, and AudioIoPort contracts; a runListenSession orchestrator over those ports; human-readable duration parsing (30s/2s/500ms); and a validated voice config section with 16kHz mono / 2s silence timeout defaults.

Real adapters shell out to local engines only: WhisperSpeechToText (whisper.cpp-style CLI), PiperTextToSpeech (Piper CLI), and SoxAudioIo (SoX capture with the silence effect; playback races a monitor process for barge-in). No cloud API, key, or billing path was added.
CLI: `viral-dev voice listen [--timeout <duration>] [--json]` wires the real adapters at the edge and runs the listen/transcribe/respond loop.

Tests (voice-duration, voice-config, voice-listen) exercise duration parsing, config validation, and the full orchestration loop (silence timeout ending a turn, interrupt/barge-in stopping playback, session timeout, max turns) against fakes; no network access or installed audio engines are required.
Verified implementation committed as 11ae572d3cb49ebb0889d9f1673fd84ca4e9ffc0 and pushed to origin/feat/m05-voice.
nextAction: Objective completed after verified changes were committed and pushed.
